_about: Copy to data/fact-ledgers/state-license/<state-slug>.json BEFORE drafting. Every fact on the page is a quote here first, from a primary source opened on the read date. scripts/check-state-license-set.ts fails the page if it states a number or a long quote that no fact carries, or if fewer than 10 state-specific facts are recorded.
officialLookupUrl: https://<the board's own lookup page, opened on the read date>

licensingBodies.name: <board name exactly as the state writes it>

relatedQueries: <first-party related queries that chose bank topics>

quirks: <what we saw that trips people up>
portalWalk.screenshot: public/images/<state-slug>-license-record.webp or a reason none was taken

facts.topic: <who-is-licensed | lookup | exemption-threshold | unlicensed-consequences | recovery-fund | contract-rules | bond-insurance | trade-licensing | local-licensing | complaints | owner-builder | other>
facts.claim: <what the page will say, in plain words>
facts.quote: <the exact words read at the source>
